d:
Bihar ki siyasat men ek bar phir bare badlav ki charcha tej ho gaee hai. kya Nishant Kumar ko dipti siem ki jimmedari saunpi ja sakti hai? is atkal ke pichhe kya hai siyasi ganit?
Janie bihar ki rajniti men chal rahi is charcha ki puri kahani aur iske sanbhavit mayne.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
